async filesystem future resolves to std::io::Result<String>

errorKindProfile.scope: decode_error_kind for Unix targets, with the AIX ENOTEMPTY conditional preserved
errorKindProfile.aliasRule: Classify actual numeric errno; ENOTSUP need not share EOPNOTSUPP on all Unix systems.

validationLimits: No Rust executable or Cargo build was run before the complete JavaScript gate passes.
Windows native OS error-code parity and opaque non-Unicode filesystem paths remain unverified.
Windows libuv error-kind names remain a coarse adapter classification without a verified underlying Win32 code.
IoError.message is a host adapter diagnostic, not a proven source-specific Rust Error Display string; lowering dependent on exact display must remain refused.
Adapters cover declared monomorphic overloads; they do not promote complete Router runtime parity.
